levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: Asbagh narrates the encounter: Ibn al-Kawwa asks and Amir al-Mu'minin answers. Whether Ali is a further link (an Imam who speaks and acts inside a narrated scene) is a ruling; the chain is written to Asbagh only.
Footnote marks (١) and (٢) and the blessing «رحمه الله» are left out.
